segments.name: Photomasks
segments.description: Manufactures high precision photomasks used as masters to transfer circuit patterns onto semiconductor wafers and FPD substrates for IC and FPD manufacturers.
segments.evidence: We operate as a single reporting segment as a manufacturer of photomasks, which are high precision quartz or glass plates containing microscopic images of electronic circuits for use in the fabrication of IC's and FPDs.

revenueModel.text: Semiconductor and FPD designers and manufacturers pay Photronics for photomasks, typically sold in sets of layers, with negotiated pricing parameters and sometimes agreed percentages of a customer's photomask orders.
revenueModel.evidence: In many instances, we enter into sales arrangements with an understanding that, as long as our performance is competitive, we will receive a specified percentage of that customer's photomask orders.
